candidate_merges.message: Keep connected terminal clipboard and selection errors console-only (#20720) ## Description A local terminal UI error can show a misleading clipboard-permission banner even though the terminal is still connected. Log these status errors to the console instead, preserving existing sizing/palette errors. Fatal disconnections still show the connection-failure banner and retry.
